national-theatre.name: National Theatre of Nigeria
national-theatre.price_text: Entry price varies by event — check on the day
national-theatre.hours: Box office and halls vary by show — check on the day
national-theatre.tip: The building's shape is famous; check what's on before you go, as the halls are event-driven.
national-theatre.best: Weekday daytime for the building; evening for a show

national-museum.name: Nigerian National Museum
national-museum.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
national-museum.hours: Weekdays roughly 09:00–17:00 — check on the day
national-museum.tip: Go with a guide or a local friend; labels are limited and the collection rewards context.

tafawa-balewa.name: Tafawa Balewa Square
tafawa-balewa.tip: Come for the independence history and the Remembrance Arcade; keep valuables close in the busy surroundings.

nike-art.name: Nike Art Gallery
nike-art.hours: Roughly 09:00–18:00 daily — check on the day
nike-art.tip: Four floors of Nigerian art; ask politely before photographing artists at work.

cathedral-christ.name: Cathedral Church of Christ
cathedral-christ.hours: Open around services — check on the day
cathedral-christ.tip: Dress modestly and avoid visiting during a service unless you plan to attend.

apapa-park.name: Apapa Amusement Park
apapa-park.price_text: Rides priced individually — check on the day
apapa-park.hours: Daytime, roughly 10:00–18:00 — check on the day
apapa-park.tip: Good for families with young kids; confirm rides are running before you travel there.

dreamworld.name: Dreamworld Africana
dreamworld.price_text: Entry and rides priced separately — check on the day
dreamworld.hours: Roughly 10:00–18:00, mostly weekends — check on the day
dreamworld.tip: A theme park for kids; bring cash and sun protection, and check opening days first.

fun-factory.name: Fun Factory
fun-factory.price_text: Pay per game — check on the day
fun-factory.tip: Indoor games and bowling; a good rainy-day option with children.

hi-impact.name: Hi-Impact Planet
hi-impact.price_text: Entry and rides priced separately — check on the day
hi-impact.tip: It sits well outside the city; plan a full day and arrange transport back in advance.

praia-dona-ana.name: Praia de Dona Ana
praia-dona-ana.hours: Daylight hours — check on the day
praia-dona-ana.tip: Confirm access and safety locally before you go; conditions change and this is not a standard tourist beach.

lekki-market.name: Lekki Market
lekki-market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
lekki-market.hours: Roughly 08:00–18:00 daily — check on the day
lekki-market.tip: Haggle politely and keep small notes; go with someone who knows the market.

freedom-park.name: Freedom Park
freedom-park.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
freedom-park.tip: A former prison turned arts and music venue; evenings often bring live shows.

third-mainland-view.name: Third Mainland Bridge viewpoint
third-mainland-view.tip: The bridge gives wide lagoon views; traffic is heavy at peak times, so go mid-morning.

victoria-island-walk.name: Victoria Island waterfront walk
victoria-island-walk.tip: Walk the business-district streets and waterfront in daytime only; take a car after dark.

lagos-food-tour.name: Lagos street food tasting
lagos-food-tour.price_text: Guided tours vary widely — check on the day
lagos-food-tour.hours: Tours usually run morning or evening
lagos-food-tour.tip: Book a guided tasting so you can try suya, jollof and puff-puff safely with a local host.
lagos-food-tour.best: Evening, when street food is busiest

ikeja-city-walk.name: Ikeja GRA neighbourhood walk
ikeja-city-walk.tip: Leafy streets and cafés near the airport; a calm half-day if you stay overnight in Ikeja.

lekki-conservation.name: Lekki Conservation Centre
lekki-conservation.price_text: Entry fee — check on the day
lekki-conservation.tip: Walk the canopy walkway early to beat the heat and see monkeys and birds.

bar-beach.name: Landmark Beach
bar-beach.price_text: Entry fee varies by day — check on the day
bar-beach.hours: Daytime into evening — check on the day
bar-beach.tip: A managed beach with food and music; book ahead on weekends and bring cash for extras.

freedom-music.name: Live music night in Victoria Island
freedom-music.price_text: Cover charge varies by venue — check on the day
freedom-music.tip: Lagos nightlife starts late; arrange a trusted driver for the ride home.

ikoyi-walk.name: Ikoyi and Banana Island drive
ikoyi-walk.price_text: Car and driver cost varies — check on the day
ikoyi-walk.tip: A short drive shows the city's wealthiest districts; use a hired car rather than walking.

jollof-lunch.name: Jollof rice lunch spot
jollof-lunch.price_text: Budget meal — check on the day
jollof-lunch.tip: Ask a local for their favourite buka; portions are big and prices low.
